scope: Conditional mature-method VAE-only exploration; not permission to launch
training_entry_conditions_all_required: Complete frozen CE baseline R/M/S evaluation of all train279/dev41 records and eight prelocked S seeds, with no missing core prediction or nonfinite prediction.
On dev41 only, deterministic M sequence-equally-weighted nonPAD accuracy minus the eight-seed mean of sequence-equally-weighted S accuracy is at least 0.05.
Root and independent reviewer confirm the bounded comparison is a falsifiable optimization-path experiment, not a claimed unique KL/variance causal diagnosis.
Exact training implementation, input/config/checkpoint/baseline identities, seeds, RNG, metrics and finite execution budgets are frozen and independently reviewed before launch.
Fresh real process/load inspection shows no other active AMP model job; root performs the single serial CPU launch.

single_intervention.baseline: Existing frozen CE21+J fixed-beta=1 VAE1000 checkpoint and training trace
single_intervention.comparison_scope: Reuses an already-observed fixed-beta baseline; one training seed and posthoc research opportunity, not matched actual cumulative compute or independent confirmation.

training_success_resource_rule_all_requi: Candidate full dev41 eight-seed S mean per-sequence nonPAD accuracy is at least baseline S + 0.05, using the exact same saved epsilon banks and identity order.
Candidate deterministic M mean per-sequence nonPAD accuracy is no lower than baseline M.
Candidate deterministic M length MAE is no greater than baseline M=0.
Candidate S amino-acid macro recall averaged over the same eight seeds is no lower than baseline S macro recall.

failure_rules.incomplete_or_numerical_failure: NOT_EVALUABLE; preserve every partial record and do not replace sequences or seeds.
failure_rules.any_complete_success_guard_fails: Do not advance this warmup route; no beta/seed/budget search under this scope.
failure_rules.entry_gap_below_threshold: No new VAE training under this conditional scope; report that the stochastic-loss hypothesis did not meet the investment rule.
failure_rules.gap_shrinkage_alone: Never success: worsening M can shrink the gap.
failure_rules.tolerance: No rounding before threshold comparisons; identity/parity tolerances are declared separately in the exact execution contract.

required_side_effect_reporting: M and S micro and per-sequence accuracy
original nine raw physicochemical descriptors with missingness
posterior sigma and prior-density/KL terms where already produced
inference_limits: The 0.05 thresholds are resource-investment rules, not significance or population-generalization claims.
Eight epsilon draws are Monte Carlo evaluations at one fitted model, not eight biological or training replicates.
A warmup effect changes optimization history and cannot isolate posterior variance as its sole mechanism.
Reconstruction improvement does not imply prior fit, generation superiority, antimicrobial activity, novelty or submission readiness.
No test37 access, no modification of original manuscripts or historical evidence.
